static_traits.name: Zhang Jie
static_traits.marital_status: Married (spouse is a former Miss America)
static_traits.family_status: Has children (the client finds the children disappointing); employs a Female domestic helper at home
static_traits.medical_history: Never had similar psychological issues before; no history of psychological treatment; No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, fairly coherent logic, highly cooperative; able to describe emotions and situations concretely; tone nervous but cooperative attitude positive

basic_info.main_problem: I am suffering from the thought that 'the marriage will end in Divorce', which causes Anxiety and pain.
basic_info.core_demands: Seeks counseling to reduce the impact of fear of divorce on mental health, daily functioning and the relationship with the spouse; hopes to improve relationship security through more open communication.

core_beliefs: I am not understood and appreciated
Intimate relationships easily end in failure

special_situations.event: An argument with the spouse a few months ago (feeling misunderstood and unappreciated at the time)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If one serious argument occurs, it means the marriage is heading toward its end
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids difficult conversations and uses work or hobbies to distract attention
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This may be the beginning of the end of our marriage; we will divorce

special_situations.event: Before interacting with the spouse or discussing important matters, even without specific problems
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I say one wrong sentence, the relationship will deteriorate and trigger an argument
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Speaks cautiously, shortens communication, tries to avoid sensitive topics
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: We will argue; I will make things worse

special_situations.event: The spouse has not directly expressed dissatisfaction, but the relationship was tense at one point
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the relationship atmosphere is tense, it means the other party is unhappy and may be considering Divorce
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces expressing true worries, avoids starting difficult conversations
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They must be dissatisfied with the marriage and may be considering Divorce

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be understood and appreciated and to maintain a stable intimate relationship
core_conflict.fear: Fearing Being rejected, relationship breakdown and abandonment
defense_goal: Avoids difficult conversations to maintain superficial peace and reduce conflict
Cautiously restrains oneself to avoid saying the wrong thing and worsening the relationship

object_relations.self_representation: A tense partner walking on 'eggshells', someone who worries about saying the wrong thing
object_relations.object_representation: A spouse who may be dissatisfied, picky, and ready to reject oneself at any time

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: Before having important conversations or intimate interactions with one's spouse, or when needing to express genuine concerns
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Interprets neutral or positive interaction as a signal of potential conflict, believing she will say the wrong thing and cause the relationship to worsen
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Avoiding direct discussion of emotions, turning to Work or other safe topics instead; cautious tone, using vague expressions, shortening exchanges as much as possible to reduce discomfort.

manifestations: Continuously worrying about relationship breakdown after one argument, Anticipating being rejected by the partner and the relationship ending
Repeatedly Anticipating arguments and misunderstandings before interacting with the spouse, walking on 'eggshells'
Feeling not understood and not appreciated
outcomes: Marriage and relationships more strained, declining interaction quality

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: Before interacting with one's spouse, excessive self-scrutiny and caution, choosing words carefully, afraid of saying the wrong thing
'Walking on eggshells' to avoid triggering conflict

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'. Language manifestations include: 'Speaking of which... haha, just kidding', 'In theory...', and so on
manifestations: Uses work or hobbies to distract attention, avoiding opening difficult topics
Displacing topics instead of directly expressing worries when feeling tense

exception_events.target_problem: Before interacting with the spouse or discussing important matters, the client usually Anticipates arguments and misunderstandings in advance, feels strong Anxiety, and therefore avoids difficult conversations.
exception_events.unique_outcome: During an activity both enjoyed (watching a movie or walking together), the client felt more relaxed, did not excessively Anticipate arguments, and the interaction was more natural.
exception_events.reason: Different situation: doing an activity both love, relaxed atmosphere; different approach: focusing on the present activity rather than worrying; relationship support: positive interaction reduced tension.

positive_force: Positive counseling attitude, willing to try behavioral experiments and open communication
Willing to record and observe interactions and emotional changes
Has a certain amount of social support (several friends to confide in)
negative_force: Cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, mind reading, and predicting the future
Avoiding difficult conversations and situations, long-term Self-monitoring, walking on 'eggshells'
Persistent anxiety leading to Disturbed sleep and appetite
Interprets tense atmosphere as a signal of relationship failure

target_behavior.behavior: Experiencing Significant anxiety and avoiding difficult conversations before and during interactions with the spouse
antecedent: When preparing to interact with the spouse or discuss important matters
After recalling the argument from a few months ago
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophic cognition and negative automatic thoughts formed after one argument (Mind Reading, Fortune Telling), accompanied by the belief of 'I am not understood and not appreciated'
target_behavior.function: Escaping potential conflict and emotional discomfort, trying to maintain surface peace
target_behavior.consequence: More strained Marriage and relationships, accumulated misunderstandings, persistent Anxiety; disturbed sleep and appetite; Decline in work performance
